observation: Two distinct round joints occupy one vertical column just outside the D6 blue socket at its package height, with roughly 220 pixels of separation. No capacitor body spans them. The lower joint visibly meets a broad front copper run; the upper joint has no unambiguous front departure in the crop. Their position and posture match C87 better than the open annuli above the sockets, but the photos do not prove the pair's refdes or supply-rail polarities.

upper_strip_d6_ground_join: Native solder crop (1750,950)-(2400,1370) resolves the right-hand D6 2×8 joint group. Its upper row has eight contacts from roughly x1850 to x2230; the rightmost contact near (2230,1050) has an uninterrupted tinned neck down to the broad strip and an outboard solder spur toward x≈2340. On the right-notched front D6 socket, the leftmost upper contact is physical pin8; reflection places it at the rightmost solder contact. The exact .009 sheet-1 power table assigns D6.8 to ground. This makes the upper broad strip a photo-visible D6.8/GND conductor, while the front C87 upper joint's same-hole identity remains unproved. The lower broad strip near y1270 does not visibly join D6.16 (+5 V) at the lower row's left end in this crop, so its rail remains open.
lower_strip_extended_trace: A wider native solder sweep of 200527310 y≈1120–1400 shows the lower broad strip continuing left from the C87 search area across the neighboring package row and past x≈0 of this tile. It has plated openings, tinned repairs, and nearby package joints, but no unbroken local B.Cu spur to D6.16 at the lower D6 row's left end. The far-left continuation and any hidden front-copper branches prevent a rail assignment from this sweep; a known +5 V contact on that same strip or direct meter continuity is needed.
d8_power_overlap_check: The lower broad strip continues through the overlap with solder tile 200525009. The established D8.16 +5 V joint is near (3120,1193) in that tile, corresponding roughly to (1292,1217) in 200527310. Native crops (2900,1030)-(3450,1350) and (1050,1070)-(1600,1370) show the D8.16 solder joint above the broad strip with a visible brown clearance on B.Cu; no direct local back-copper bridge to the strip is exposed. lower_strip_right_endpoint: A wide y=1120..1460 sweep and native crop (2750,1000)-(3550,1450) of solder tile 200527310 show the lower broad C87-search strip continuing right, below a separate seven-joint row, to an exposed open annulus near (3355,1265). The annulus is a more specific lower-strip continuity target than the unresolved C87 candidate feature near (2310,1280), but it does not itself identify +5 V or a C87 hole.
decision: Promote these as C87 inspection candidates only. Do not assign C87 population, pad numbering, or +5 V/GND nets from proximity.
